name: Everyday Notebook
description: Deep green cloth cover, 160 lined pages and a ribbon marker. A simple place for notes, ideas and everyday lists.

name: Weekly Desk Planner
description: An undated weekly planner with room for appointments, priorities and small reminders. Start any week of the year.

name: Brass Writing Pen
description: A balanced refillable writing pen with a warm brass finish and a smooth black ink refill.

name: Canvas Pencil Case
description: A compact zip case for pens, pencils and small desk essentials. Soft canvas with a sturdy cotton lining.

name: Everyday Canvas Tote
description: A roomy cotton canvas tote with comfortable handles and an inside pocket. Built for daily errands and all the small things you carry.

name: Pocket Zip Pouch
description: Keep keys, coins and little essentials together in this soft zip pouch. A small companion for a larger bag.

name: Reusable Water Bottle
description: A 600 ml reusable bottle with a screw-top lid and a clean, simple shape. For your desk, day bag or a short walk.

name: Everyday Key Loop
description: A woven loop with a metal ring and clip. Easy to spot in the bottom of a bag.

name: Studio Ceramic Mug
description: A generous ceramic mug with a comfortable handle and a softly curved shape. A calm addition to a morning routine.

name: Bud Vase
description: A small sculptural vase for a single stem or a few dried flowers. A simple accent for a shelf or side table.

name: Amber Jar Candle
description: A warm amber-colored candle jar with a fitted lid. An understated gift or a finishing touch for a cozy corner.

name: Small Ceramic Planter
description: A small ceramic planter for a favorite houseplant. Clean lines and an easy-to-style neutral finish. Plant not included.

name: Insulated Travel Cup
description: A compact insulated cup with a fitted lid. A simple reusable companion for the daily commute.

name: Compact Umbrella
description: A compact folding umbrella with a wrist loop and matching sleeve. Small enough to keep in an everyday bag.

name: Canvas Weekender
description: A roomy canvas bag for an overnight stay or a light weekend away. Includes top handles and an adjustable shoulder strap.

name: Soft Woven Scarf
description: A soft woven scarf in a versatile neutral tone. Light enough for layering, with a gently fringed edge.

name: Everyday Gift Box
description: A ready-to-give selection of small everyday essentials, presented in a reusable box. Select optional wrapping for a finished gift.

name: Notebook Duo
description: Two coordinating notebooks for work and personal notes. A thoughtful gift for someone who always has a new idea.

name: Cotton Tea Towel Pair
description: A pair of soft cotton tea towels with a simple woven stripe. Useful, washable and easy to fold away.

name: Desk Essentials Set
description: A coordinated desk set combining a notebook, pen and small tray. This demo item is intentionally unavailable online.

name: Soft Cotton Throw
description: A soft cotton throw with a subtle woven texture and fringed ends. Fold over a chair or keep close on a cool evening.

name: Woven Storage Basket
description: A textured basket for soft goods and small household items. This demo item is intentionally unavailable online.

name: Small Ceramic Tray
description: A low ceramic tray for keys, jewelry or small desk objects. Available at the Market Annex demo location.

name: Simple Greeting Card
description: An unprinted-inside greeting card for a short note. This item intentionally has no image so the storefront fallback can be reviewed.
